hooks.text: The Sun is the most perfectly round object in nature.
The Sun contains 99.86 percent of all mass nearby.
Violent magnetic storms cannot change the Sun's perfect shape.

title: The Sun is the most perfectly round object in nature
description: NASA measurements from the Solar Dynamics Observatory show that the Sun holds a nearly perfect round shape despite violent magnetic cycles. It contains over 99 percent of all mass in our solar system.

beats.text: The Sun is the most perfectly round object in nature.
beats.visual: Full disk of the Sun captured by SDO in visible light showing its perfect circularity, 2012

beats.text: It holds ninety-nine point eight six percent of our system's mass.
beats.visual: Artist illustration of the Sun and all planets showing their relative mass scale, 2018

beats.text: Every planet and asteroid is just a tiny leftover.
beats.visual: Diagram showing planetary mass vs the overwhelming solar mass, 2010

beats.text: Yet even violent magnetic storms cannot bulge its disk.
beats.visual: Close up of an active solar region with glowing magnetic loops from SDO, 2014
queries: Solar magnetic field lines coronal loops SDO

beats.text: NASA's Solar Dynamics Observatory measured this shape from space.
beats.visual: The SDO spacecraft in flight during its solar observation mission, 2012

beats.text: To calculate this weight, scientists first weighed the Earth.
beats.visual: Earth as seen from deep space by the Apollo 17 crew, 1972
queries: Earth as seen from space Apollo 17 Blue Marble

beats.text: Henry Cavendish used a torsion balance in seventeen ninety-eight.
beats.visual: Diagram of the Cavendish torsion balance experiment to measure gravity, 1798

beats.text: Deep inside, fusion generates ninety-nine percent of its power.
beats.visual: Cross section diagram showing nuclear fusion occurring inside the Sun's core, 2015
queries: Proton proton chain nuclear fusion diagram

beats.text: This power creates the heliosphere, a giant magnetic shield.
beats.visual: Diagram showing the heliosphere shielding the planets from cosmic rays, 2013

beats.text: Through every violent cycle, it remains a perfect sphere.
beats.visual: High resolution view of the Sun's perfect circular limb from SDO, 2012
